job.description:

job.title: Podiatrist
job.description:
Our client is seeking empathetic and motivated mobile podiatrists to join their growing Allied Health team, delivering mobile services across Residential Aged Care facilities and community settings throughout Australia. This mobile role offers variety, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of older Australians by supporting mobility, comfort, independence, and overall wellbeing. As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will provide evidence-based podiatry services including assessments, treatment, prevention, education, and rehabilitation for a reconstructions including hips and knees , with services delivered in clients' homes, aged care facilities and, where appropriate, via telehealth.   • Conduct comprehensive podiatry assessments and deliver evidence-based treatment plans to support foot health, mobility, comfort and independence.

  • Collaborate with clients, families, aged care staff, GPs and the wider Allied Health team to deliver coordinated, person-centred care.
  • Maintain accurate clinical documentation and contribute to high standards of clinical governance, quality improvement and service delivery

  • Bachelor of Podiatry (or equivalent qualification).
  • Current unrestricted AHPRA registration as a Podiatrist.
  • Previous experience in Residential Aged Care and/or community health settings is highly regarded.
  • Strong clinical assessment, treatment planning and problem-solving skills.
  • Current Driver's Licence and access to a car and willingness to travel throughout the region.
  • Passion for delivering person-centred care and improving outcomes for older Australians.

What's on Offer
  • Opportunity to join a leading provider with a strong reputation in community and aged care services.
  • Diverse caseload across residential aged care and community settings.
  • Autonomous and rewarding role with flexible service delivery options.

job.title: Personal Care Assistant
job.description:
We are seeking a compassionate and experienced PCA to join our team at Rosary Home in a full-time role, Monday to Friday from 6:30am to 2:30pm. In this rewarding position, you will support residents with daily living activities including showering, dressing, grooming, assisted care, light domestic duties, and guiding them to meals and activities. You will deliver high-quality, person-centred care in line with individual care plans and the Aged Care Quality Standards.

Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Assists residents with showering, dressing, grooming, assisted care, domestic assistance, and guiding residents to their activities and mealtimes
  • Assists residents with activities of daily living including (but are not limited) to personal hygiene, toileting, nutrition, and mobility.
  • Provide personal care needs and services as per consumer’s individual care needs and care plans
  • Provide person-centred care to residents in accordance with the Aged Care Quality Standards
  • Contribute to the provision of holistic care in accordance with residents’ choice as per their individual care plan
  • Perform personal care activities contained in the care plan to assist the resident with their activities of daily living. The Personal Care Assistant performs the assigned tasks as instructed by the Registered Nurse in the Care Plan.
  • Actively participate in identifying resident care needs, implementing and evaluating the needs in conjunction with the Registered Nurse.
  • Actively participate in assisting residents to maintain dignity and choice
  • Undertake general housekeeping duties
  • Adhere to Occupational Health and Safety and Infection Control policies.
  • Communicate effectively with residents, the Operation Manager and the wider care team
  • Accurate documentation of any resident care issues and care services provided, including adverse events and enhancements to care plans using ECASE
  • Work co-operatively as part of the wider care team.
  • Encourage and assist residents to maximise their independence
  • Comply with and apply compulsory reporting requirements in accordance with relevant legislation.


Required Skills and Abilities:
  • Completed Cert IV in Individual Support or Aged Care
  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience  
  • Level 2 First Aid Certificate
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated ability to use judgement, initiative and common sense when performing duties
  • Current national police check clearance
  •  Up-to-date Influenza vaccination

job.title: Nurse Practitioner (Mt Gambier)
job.description:
We are currently seeking an experienced Nurse Practitioner to join our clients primary care team and support our General Practitioners in providing care to patients residing in Residential Aged Care Facilities (RACFs) in Mt Gambier. 

Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Work collaboratively with our Senior Medical Officer and General Practitioners and ensure the highest level of care is provided to our patients and reduce hospital admissions.
  • Triaging incoming requests from the RACFs allocated to you and conducting weekly onsite visits.
  • Coordinate care between GPs, aged care staff, residents, and families ensuring continuity of quality care.
  • Provide primary care services which may include:
    • taking medical history
    • undertaking clinical examination
    • arranging any necessary investigations
    • implementing a management plan
    • providing appropriate preventive health care
  • Contribute to health assessments and medication management for new resident admissions.
  • Prepare annual health assessment reviews for existing residents.
  • Conduct regular reviews and follow ups with aged care residents through professional attendance.
  • There may be opportunity to work from home once relationships with the nursing homes and patients are established.

  • Registration with AHPRA and endorsed as a Nurse Practitioner.
  • Permitted to work in Australia.
  • Hold or have the ability to apply for a Medicare provider number.
  • Hold your own professional indemnity insurance 
  • Great attitude and able to work in collaboration with our Senior Medical officer.
